Subject: MAP ops check-in — data handling & deployment decision calendar

Hi Lydia / Tom,

Quick weekly MAP check-in from our side — attached is the updated MAP_v2 (see attachment) and a lightweight data map for PII fields. High-level items for this week:

- Deployment modes to finalize: VPC-hosted (managed control plane) vs on-prem (air-gapped appliance) — tradeoffs summarized on page 3 of the MAP.
- Retention policy options we discussed: (A) 30 days KV cache + 180d logs; (B) 0 retention for inputs, ephemeral KV only (strict PII posture).
- Pending: Acme security review of encryption-at-rest keys and on-prem network firewall rules.

Planned timeline (proposal):
- By 2026-06-25: Acme confirms preferred deployment mode (VPC or on-prem) and required retention baseline.
- By 2026-07-02: If on-prem selected, exchange install checklist and schedule enclave review. If VPC selected, finalize KMS integration plan and subnetwork requirements.

Action items for this email thread (owners are internal unless otherwise noted):
1) Marcus — prepare decision matrix comparing latency/cost/security for Acme workload (attachment referenced). Due 6/24.
2) Olga — draft KMS options and key-management responsibilities for both VPC and on-prem. Due 6/25.
3) Karthik — confirm default tokenization/PII suppression options and sample retention lifecycle. Due 6/25.
4) Acme Security (Lydia/Tom) — confirm whether external auditors require data residency in a specific region and if on-prem is a firm requirement. Due 6/25.

Attachments: MAP_v2_Acme_20260622.pdf; PII_Data_Map_Acme.xlsx.

Short meeting window available next Tue/Wed if you prefer to talk through — otherwise reply with the selection and we'll convert these items into a formal change request.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin

Subject: Re: MAP ops check-in — data handling & deployment decision calendar

Thanks Marcus — quick clarifications from Acme Security: 

- On-prem is preferred for PHI tokenization workflows, but we can consider VPC in a dedicated region if Redwood can guarantee customer-managed KMS and HSM-backed keys.
- Retention: our baseline is 90 days for audit logs and 0-30 days for request payloads depending on classification. We need an explicit option to zero-out inputs after generation for high-sensitivity flows.

Can you add a column in your decision matrix that calls out how each option supports: encrypted keys (customer-managed), data residency, and zero-input retention (yes/no) for high-sensitivity flags?

Also: attached is a short compliance checklist from our side; Tom will be the primary for the enclave review scheduling.

Lydia Park
Lead Procurement, Acme Health
lydia.park@acmehealth.com

(attachment stub: Acme_Compliance_Checklist_20260623.pdf - 120KB, PDF)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP ops check-in — data handling & deployment decision calendar

Lydia — appreciate the specifics. Per request I updated the decision matrix and attached a short two-page appendix called "deployment-comparison" (embedded in MAP_v2). Key callouts:

- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS via Bring-Your-Key (BYK) for VPC. For on-prem we can integrate with customer HSM or provide a connector for common KMS vendors; responsibilities are described in the appendix.
- Zero-input retention: We can enable a pipeline-level flag (sensitivity=true) that drops request payloads post-response and retains only hashed metadata for telemetry. This is available for both VPC and on-prem.
- Network controls: On-prem requires inbound HTTPS to the appliance for admin only; data plane can be fully air-gapped depending on required features. See page 4 of MAP_v2 for firewall examples.

Updated timeline and next steps (converted from earlier asks):
- 2026-06-25: Acme to confirm preferred mode + retention baseline (ACTION: Acme) — Lydia/Tom
- 2026-06-29: Redwood internal readiness check and install checklist prepared (ACTION: Olga)
- 2026-07-02: Enclave/network review slot with Acme Security (ACTION: Tom to schedule)
- 2026-07-06: Pilot kick-off (if VPC) or on-site appliance delivery window (if on-prem)

Action owners (explicit):
- Marcus: attach decision matrix (done), follow-up on KMS integration diagram (due 6/26).
- Olga: produce install checklist and RSA/HSM integration notes (due 6/29).
- Karthik: finalize PII suppression implementation plan and sample retention lifecycle for the pilot (due 6/26).
- Priya: create demo prompts and eval set that exclude PHI for initial pilot (due 6/30).

Tom/Lydia — if that sequencing works, please reply with the selected deployment mode and any hard blockers. I can run a 30-minute call Tuesday (6/29) 10:00-10:30 PST to walk the matrix if helpful.

Best,
Marcus

(attachment stub: MAP_v2_Acme_20260625_deployment-comparison.pdf - 520KB, PDF)
